title: Missed reading alert does not trigger for xDrip Sync follower
symptom: Missed reading alert does not trigger for xDrip Sync follower. When set to trigger after 6 minutes of no readings, disabling WiFi with no sim card does not trigger the alert, whereas the same test as a Nightscout follower does trigger it.
cause: The missed reading alert is not active unless there is a local sensor. There is a line in the code that creates a local sensor for a Nightscout follower if one does not exist, but there isn't one for xDrip Sync.
fix: Fixed in release 2025.06.17. The fix involved removing the requirement for a local sensor for xDrip Sync follower.
evidence_quote: I see that the missed reading alert is not active unless there is a local sensor. I see that there is a line in the code that creates a local sensor for a Nightscout follower if one does not exist. But, there isn't one for xDrip Sync. I am going to experiment with removing the requirement for a local sensor for xDrip Sync follower and if my tests succeed, open a PR.
